desk.hiLight: Hi Light — boosts the selected fixtures to full (latched; not stored in the programmer). Click to toggle.
desk.fan: Fan — fan mode: while on, turn a wheel and the attribute spreads across the selection (the centre stays). Click to toggle.
desk.patch: Patch — opens the Patch menu and the patch panel (PWA)
desk.viewOpen: View/Open — opens Workspaces: recall a saved layout or record the current one (Record Workspace)
desk.prevCue: Prev Cue — previous step of the connected playback
desk.nextCue: Next Cue — next step of the connected playback
desk.go: Go — advances the connected playback to the next cue
desk.fixtureKey: Fixture — selection (the fixtures window is on the right)
desk.avo: avo (Avolites) — second functions (the blue ones). On the real Quartz you HOLD it while pressing another key; here it latches (click to toggle).
desk.time: Time — Go fade: {{secs}}s (click to change; 0 = Snap)
desk.clear: Clear — empties the programmer and deselects
desk.exit: Exit — back to the root menu / clear the line
desk.execFixed: Executor {{n}} — {{label}} (fixed function; not in the simulator yet)
desk.flashKey: {{label}} · key {{key}} (hold to flash; several at once)
desk.swopKey: {{label}} · key {{key}} (hold to swop). Caps Lock + key = executor.
desk.flashName: Flash {{name}} — {{state}}. On the real Quartz it's momentary (hold); here it's a toggle.
desk.swopName: Swop {{name}} — {{state}}. On the real Quartz it's momentary; here it's a toggle.
desk.connect: Connect/Cue — connects a playback to the central transport without firing it
desk.connectArmed: Connect armed — touch a playback to connect it to the central Go (without firing)
desk.execRecordHere: Executor {{n}} — click to record the current look here
desk.execLabelPrompt: Executor {{n}} — type its label (empty to clear)

patch.addTrussHint: Add a truss to the rig

patch.readdressHint: Reorder fixtures left→right and re-assign DMX addresses, as a real rig is patched (address follows the cable run)
patch.empty: No fixtures yet — add one from the library.
patch.name: Name

visualizer.note: 2D top view now; 3D (Three.js) in a later phase.
